Hi Alicia / Samir,

Hope things are going well — quick ask from our side. Would you be willing to leave a brief review of Redwood on G2? It only takes ~3 minutes and helps our product team and other buyers a lot. To make it worth your time, we'd like to send a $75 digital coffee credit to each reviewer.

If that sounds OK, here's the lightweight flow:
- Click this link: https://www.g2.com/products/redwood-inference/reviews/new (attached as a shortcut)
- Pick 3 short bullets about what you like (speed, reliability, or cost controls are great to mention)
- Optionally add one quick line about your use case (pilot -> production, dedicated capacity)

I've attached a one-page checklist with sample blurbs to make it painless. If you prefer Capterra instead of G2, we can send that link instead. If you'd like us to review your draft before you post, happy to do that.

Note for internal tracking: HubSpot deal DEAL-7831.

Thanks so much — totally understand if now's not a good time. If you confirm, we'll queue the e-gift to the address you reply from.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Thanks for the note — we're happy to help. A couple quick questions before we post:
1) Is there any mandatory language (e.g., on data usage) we need to include?
2) Do you need the review to be about our pilot only, or broader (we're starting production in a couple months)?
3) What's the timeline for the credit? Samir prefers to have the exact details up front.

If you can send me the two-line sample and the checklist (I see it's attached) I'll run it by our legal reviewer. If we're clear on the language we can likely post by Monday (Nov 15).

Thanks,
Alicia

Thanks for the quick reply, Alicia — great questions. Short answers below and I've pasted a two-line sample you can use.

1) Mandatory language: None required for G2 reviews. If you'd like us to include a disclosure line we can provide: "GreenGrid Energy is a customer of Redwood Inference; this review reflects our experience."
2) Scope: either is fine. If you'd like to mention the pilot only, we recommend calling out the specific success (e.g., reduced per-token latency during inference by X%). If you'd prefer a forward-looking statement about production readiness, that's also helpful.
3) Timeline for credit: once the review is live, we'll send the $75 digital credit within 48 business hours to the email you post from. The gift will come from redwood-gifts@redwood.com and the attached instructions explain redemption.

Two-line sample you can copy:
"GreenGrid Energy uses Redwood Inference for low-latency inference in our pilot workflows. The platform gave us predictable throughput and easier rollout controls compared to what we used previously."

Checklist (attached):
- Visit the link: https://www.g2.com/products/redwood-inference/reviews/new
- Select rating (4-5 recommended if positive)
- Paste one of the sample blurbs above or write 1-2 lines about your use case
- Optional: add a sentence on reliability/latency/cost savings

I'll mark HubSpot DEAL-7831 as "reference requested" and loop Rishi for the follow-up so we don't miss the timeline. If you'd rather post on Capterra, let me know and I'll swap the link.

If you'd like to route the e-gift to Samir, confirm that below and we'll send it after the review is posted.

Appreciate it — happy to approve a draft if you want to send one.

Best,
Olga

Attachments: g2-review-quick-checklist.pdf, egift-instructions.txt
